name: Tilted Card
description: Image card with spring-driven 3D tilt that follows the pointer, with parallax layers, glare, rim light, soft shadow, floating idle motion, click-to-flip back face and a cursor-following caption.
contents: Front face with image, optional children layers, glare and rim light
Optional back face shown by flipping
Optional overlay content floating above the image in 3D
Soft blurred shadow under the card
behavior: Card tilts toward the pointer with spring physics and scales up on hover
Glare and edge highlight move with the tilt
Layers shift with parallax based on tilt, TiltedCardLayer exported for custom depth layers
Intro fade and rise starts when the card enters the viewport
Optional floating idle motion and optional tracking of the pointer across the whole window
On touch devices uses device orientation (gyroscope) and asks motion permission on iOS
Click or Enter/Space flips to the back face when backContent is set, controlled or uncontrolled
Animation loop sleeps when settled or offscreen
Reduced motion setting lowers tilt and disables intro and floating
editableByProps: Image, alt text, caption, card and image sizes, corner radius
Tilt strength, hover scale, smoothness, perspective, axis lock, reversed direction
Glare intensity and color, shadow strength, parallax depth
Back face content, flip behavior and controlled flip state
Overlay content and its depth, custom children layers
Floating idle motion, window tracking, gyroscope, intro and its delay

needsCodeEdit.where: figcaption element classes at the end of the TiltedCard JSX

needsCodeEdit.change: Change spring stiffness or flip speed
needsCodeEdit.where: step calls for 'flip' and 'press' inside the frame function

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how far the cursor must move before a press stops counting as a click

fixed: Client component, needs Tailwind CSS for all styling
Listens to window pointermove, pointerup, pointercancel, deviceorientation and document pointerleave while mounted
Requests device motion permission on touch devices on first press when gyroscope is on
Tilt is limited to 0 to 60 degrees and hover scale to at least 0.5
Front image is enlarged by a computed bleed so parallax never shows edges
Tooltip only shows on mouse or pen hover, not touch
Flip needs backContent, otherwise the card is not interactive unless onClick is set
Tilt effect is designed for pointer devices, touch uses gyroscope or press tilt
Vertical page scroll is allowed on the card on touch (touch-action pan-y)
